name: diss-desktop
description: Diss — video meetings for macOS and Windows
author: Diss

scripts.prepack:renderer: npm --prefix ../app run build -- --base=./ && rm -rf renderer && cp -R ../app/dist renderer
scripts.pack: npm run icon && npm run prepack:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icon && npm run prepack:renderer && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run icon && npm run prepack:renderer && electron-builder --win

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Diss needs your camera so people in the meeting can see you.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Diss needs your microphone so people in the meeting can hear you.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Diss needs access to system audio when you choose to share computer sound in a meeting.
